title: Guest's attempt to show Aldrin UAP imagery

tellings.quote: I've actually tried to approach him uh through one of his assistants at Balls Alter Ventures about showing him some of the Apollo 11 imagery of UAP that I've found uh and also the Apollo 17 imagery. I got a polite reply

plain: A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani says he found UAP, the government's term for UFOs, in photos from Apollo 11 and Apollo 17, two of NASA's missions to the Moon. He says that in the 2020s he tried to show these images to Buzz Aldrin, the Apollo 11 astronaut, by writing to one of his assistants at Aldrin's company, Buzz Aldrin Ventures, and got a polite reply. He tells it because, if his finds are real, a man who walked on the Moon might have something to say about them.
